headline: MiniMax M3 takes a 22-place tumble while DeepSeek keeps the top spot warm
summary: The day's biggest move belongs to MiniMax's M3, which slid 22 places to 46th. Two new models made the board at 40th and 44th, and DeepSeek's v4.1 Flash still sits comfortably on top at 22.4%.
highlights: minimax/minimax-m3-20260531 dropped 22 places to 46th, with a 0.2% token share.
New entrants: openai/gpt-6.1-terra-20261026 at 40th and qwen/qwen3.7-flash-20260727 at 44th.
Dropouts: openai/gpt-6-sol-20260922 (last ranked 45th) and google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403 (last ranked 48th).
minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash-20261019 is on day 4 of its all-time token share record, at 3.1% and ranked 8th.
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 leads the board at 22.4%, and the top two providers, DeepSeek and Zhipu AI, hold 46.1% combined.
